source_segments.text: bid us adieu , perhaps not too many people noticed or cared -- but those of us who did shook our heads and heaved a heavy , regretful sigh .
We knew your time had come ; it was obvious .
Math-rock was on the inevitable slide , especially heavy instrumental math-rock like yours .
Too few ideas , too many bands , drawing upon too few sources .
So you got out while the getting was good , after releasing just one full-length , a couple EPs , and a single .
